children: OPKO Health entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement to sell BioReference’s clinical and anatomic pathology lab testing assets to Labcorp. The deal includes $722 million in cash at closing, subject to revenue-based adjustments, plus up to $150 million over up to ten years tied to sales of the 4Kscore prostate cancer test. Closing is subject to customary conditions, including HSR clearance, and is not contingent on financing. If the deal is terminated for specified antitrust or governmental-approval failures, Labcorp would pay OPKO a $28.88 million termination fee.
